fb1fa0.title: Root reachability checks through scope proxy
fb1fa0.content: Read-only reachability checks were sent through the configured Scope proxy (explicit `curl --proxy ... --noproxy ''`). `https://127.0.0.1/` failed to establish CONNECT with `CONNECT tunnel failed, response 502`; `http://127.0.0.1/` returned HTTP 502. Captured HTTP evidence ID `5c7ae969-2243-4188-b66d-a7a97e165027` is a scope-allowed HEAD request with no upstream response. An `httpx` HTTP/HTTPS read-only run emitted no results.
